proves.claim: A proof phase that is red only because a file failed as a whole (no case named, the spec footer's failed-file list naming it) gives a ledger whose row for that file is a fail at the same input key a passing run carries, and boardJobQueueCall records that row from the posted gate receipt.

api.gate.receipt-file-red-key.whole-file.why: Without the key the board could not compare a file-level red with main, so mainRedFileExcuse refused it and the item sat on an unknown gate.

proves.claim: A red phase that names neither a failing case nor a failed file gives no ledger, so no row is guessed.

api.gate.receipt-file-red-key.no-named-f.why: Without the guard a red with no account would mark every keyed file failed or passed on a guess.
